title: Social Media Coordinator
description:
Field & Stream is seeking a Social Media Coordinator (FTE) to support the daily execution, organization, and performance tracking of the brand’s social media publishing across platforms.

ABOUT FIELD & STREAM
Field & Stream is the world's leading outdoor lifestyle brand. With origins dating back to 1871, F&S has taught a nation to hunt and fish, to camp and explore, to survive and thrive in the outdoors—all while leading the charge to conserve and fight for wildlife and wild places. In 2024, the legacy brand was unified under the same ownership for the first time in its history, including key investors and country music artists Eric Church and Morgan Wallen.

ABOUT THE ROLE
The Social Media Coordinator is responsible for the day-to-day execution of Field & Stream’s social publishing. This role ensures content is published accurately, consistently, and on schedule across platforms, while supporting performance tracking, reporting, and campaign organization.

This is a hands-on role ideal for someone who loves the outdoors, understands social platforms instinctively, and is eager to learn how a major media brand operates at scale.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Program and publish posts across Field & Stream’s social media channels
• Maintain daily and weekly social publishing calendars
• Tag, organize, and track content for campaigns and partners using Sprinklr and Airtable
• Ensure accuracy across captions, links, credits, and hashtags
• Coordinate with editors, producers, and brand partners to gather assets and information
• Monitor comments and community engagement, flagging trends or issues as needed
• Track post-level performance and assist with compiling basic performance reports
• Support launches, seasonal moments, and tentpole editorial events.
requirements:
Required:
• 1+ years of experience in social media, digital media, or a related field
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
• Working knowledge of Google Workspace
• Familiarity with major social platforms including Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and TikTok
• Experience using or willingness to learn social publishing and organization tools (Sprinklr, Airtable, Canva, or Adobe Creative Suite)
• Active participation in the outdoor lifestyle (hunting, fishing, camping, hiking, etc.)
• Strong organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail
• Comfort working within established systems, tools, and processes
• Awareness of trending formats, sounds, and behaviors on Instagram and TikTok

Preferred:
• Basic video editing experience using Adobe Premiere
• Prior experience supporting a media brand, publisher, or content-driven organization

Note: Applicants who are unable to provide five examples of brand posts and/or relevant social media links will not be considered.

title: Social Media & Content Strategist
description: We are seeking a creative and strategic Social Media & Content Strategist to manage our client's digital presence, develop engaging content, and drive brand visibility. The ideal candidate should have strong content creation skills and experience managing social media platforms, particularly within the food and hospitality industry.
requirements:
• Proven experience in social media management, content creation, or a related role.
• Strong photography, videography, and storytelling skills.
• Good knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, and social media trends.
• Excellent communication, creativity, and organisational skills.
• Experience in the food, hospitality, or lifestyle industry is an advantage.
• Ability to work flexibly and visit the restaurant for content creation.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
At Trail Lust Wander, we are passionate about outdoor exploration, adventure, and sharing the beauty of nature with the world. Our team is made up of enthusiastic, talented individuals who are as dedicated to the outdoors as they are to creating high-quality, inspiring content.

We’re always on the lookout for new talent to join us in our mission to empower adventurers of all levels. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for the wilderness and have the skills to match, we’d love to hear from you.

Why Work with Trail Lust Wander?
• Passion-Driven Culture: Our team is united by a love for adventure and a commitment to inspiring others to explore the great outdoors. We value creativity, innovation, and a deep connection with nature.
• Remote Work Opportunities: Enjoy the flexibility to work remotely and blend your professional life with your outdoor passions.
• Growth and Learning: Continuous opportunities to expand your skills, take on new challenges, and grow with the company.
• Collaborative Environment: A supportive workplace where every team member’s ideas are valued and directly impact the platform’s success.
requirements:
• Passion for outdoor exploration, adventure, and nature
• Strong social media management skills and experience creating high-quality, inspiring content
• Ability to thrive in a remote, collaborative environment
• Creativity, innovation, and a deep connection with the outdoors
• Enthusiasm for empowering adventurers of all levels
• Relevant experience in social media or content creation (preferred)

title: Content Creators & Experience Providers
description:
Local Host is actively looking for independent content creators, business owners, and service providers who are already offering unique services or experiences and would love to share them with our growing community.

We're using our Local Host social media platforms to highlight the people, businesses, talents, and experiences that make our community special.

How We Can Collaborate:
• Content Reposts: We'll share your existing content across Local Host's social media platforms (with permission and proper credit).
• Guest Features: Partner with us as a featured guest to showcase your expertise, services, or experiences.
• Community Spotlights: Highlight your business, creative work, or upcoming experiences through our community-focused content.

Who We're Looking For:
Independent content creators, local businesses, artists, performers, instructors, wellness/beauty/food/lifestyle providers, and entrepreneurs hosting classes, workshops, or community experiences.
requirements:
• Must already offer an established service, business, or experience
• Must have original content, a portfolio, or social media presence showcasing your work
• Must offer services or experiences accessible to the Redding community
• For paid contractor collaborations, must qualify as an independent contractor under California law
• Located in or serving Redding, California preferred
• Active social media presence required

title: TikTok UGC Content Creator
description:
Inform Social Media is seeking 1–2 talented UGC creators to produce engaging, sales-focused TikTok videos for our brand clients.

We build and manage TikTok Shop affiliate programs across sports, outdoor games, wellness, snacks, beverages, and other consumer products. We’re looking for creators who can demonstrate products naturally, capture attention with strong hooks, and give viewers a clear reason to buy.

Responsibilities:
• Film and edit short vertical videos featuring products provided for each assignment
• Create product demonstrations, unboxings, and engaging storytelling content
• Develop different hooks and content angles alongside our team
• Deliver finished videos on agreed deadlines and incorporate feedback
• Provide content for organic posting on our company’s and clients’ social accounts

This is a remote, project-based contract opportunity with a flexible schedule. Assignment volume will vary with client needs.
requirements:
• A portfolio of strong UGC or TikTok product videos
• Comfortable speaking on camera and demonstrating products
• Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, storytelling, and calls to action
• Access to a smartphone or camera with clear video, sound, and lighting
• Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines
• TikTok Shop experience and examples of content that generated sales are a plus
• Large following is not required — content quality is prioritized

Compensation:
• $15 per finished video meeting the agreed brief
• Additional $10 bonus per eligible sale attributed to your content
• Additional 20% commission on eligible attributed sales

title: Remote High-Ticket Closer
description:
We’re a fast-growing company in the attorney coaching and consulting space, helping experienced lawyers build high-income businesses beyond the traditional billable-hour model.

We’re currently hiring 3 experienced remote closers to join our sales team.

This is a high-performance inbound closing role. You’ll speak directly with qualified attorney leads who have already applied through our marketing funnels. No cold calling. No outbound prospecting.

What You’ll Do:
• Take inbound Zoom sales calls with qualified attorney leads
• Present and close our $12.8K high-ticket coaching offer
• Build rapport quickly with high-level professionals
• Identify client goals, challenges, and opportunities
• Handle objections with confidence and clarity
• Follow up with warm prospects as needed
• Maintain accurate CRM notes and pipeline updates
requirements:
• 1+ year of high-ticket closing experience (remote preferred)
• Strong communication and sales conversation control
• Comfortable selling over Zoom
• Confident handling objections and asking for the close
• Professional, reliable, and self-managed
• Coachable, driven, and competitive mindset
• Experience in coaching, consulting, SaaS, info-product, or education sales is a plus

title: EFCC Recruitment 2026 – Multiple Positions
description:
The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission is inviting qualified Nigerians to apply for positions across four cadres. Applications are open until 1 November 2026. The process is completely free of charge.

Available Cadres:

A. Detective Superintendent (Assistant Superintendent of EFCC II – GL 08)
Age: 18–30
Qualification: Bachelor’s degree or Higher National Diploma + valid NYSC discharge/exemption certificate

B. Detective Inspector (Inspector of EFCC II – GL 06)
Age: 18–27
Qualification: National Diploma (ND) or National Certificate in Education (NCE)

C. Detective Assistant (Detective Assistant II – GL 04)
Age: 18–25
Qualification: Minimum of five credit passes in WAEC/NECO/GCE/NABTEB including English and Mathematics (not more than two sittings)

D. Professionals / Skilled Workers
Age: 18–40
Fields include: Medicine, Pharmacy, Law, Nursing, Medical Laboratory Science, Engineering, HR, Financial Analyst, Media & Publicity, Policy Analyst, Legal Officer, Research Officer, Planning (M&E), Librarian, Estate Surveyors, IT Professional, Driver, Administrative/Clerical Officer.
Requirement: Relevant qualification + NYSC discharge/exemption certificate. Professional membership is an added advantage.
requirements:
General Requirements:
• Must be a Nigerian citizen
• Possess basic computer skills
• Be medically fit (evidence from government-approved hospital)
• No tattoos on any part of the body
• No criminal record
• One application only (multiple applications lead to disqualification)

For Cadets (A–C):
• Must be single
• Male: minimum height 1.67m
• Female: minimum height 1.64m

For Professionals/Skilled Workers:
• Valid National Driver’s Licence is an added advantage
• Must demonstrate good character and integrity
